name: prisma-bloc
vibe: A designed poster in motion. Flat saturated colour fields that hard-cut scene to scene, warm paper grounds alternating with vermilion / ultramarine / solar-yellow / jade blocks, Archivo Black mega type that crosses a travelling continuity seam, sticker chips with 4px ink outlines and hard offset shadows, a halftone dot rain and a live grain plate. NO glass, NO bloom, NO gradients-as-mood — the motion is block wipes driving in from a rotating edge, mask reveals, pops and draws. Screenshots ride real browser and phone mockups that SCROLL their capture like a product demo. Authored portrait-first (9:16) as a native GSAP + SVG/CSS composition. Best for bold, graphic, product-led brands that need to survive being watched muted on a phone.
